items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 7:1
items.html: The third discernment of the externality, which is the externality of the externality of the back, which is Malchut — behold, regarding her there is here no additional fall because of the second restriction, since she was already the aspect of the conclusion of the feet of AK also from the first restriction. Rather, afterward, when the two upper discernments of the externality had already fallen from this Malchut and became an empty void, they caused her greater darkness, for she necessarily descended even further below them; and then Malchut too was made in her value into the aspect of an empty void and an empty vessel. (Item 5).
